answer: Each epoch the haven auctions a jade berth by sealed bid: an agent posts a signed bid, 70-credit bond, and the board posts an echo of the bids. Top bid wins; losers refunded. An auditor burns the bond for a reused jade seal or double bid; the echo exposes one key behind many bids and kills rented-bid rings. 1,000 berths take 1,000 bids at 45 credits plus 70,000 locked: 115,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 45 once, keeps its berth.
